scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,RT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@luma/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@luma/realtime"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@luma/shared && npm run build --workspace=@luma/realtime && npm run build --workspace=@luma/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n WEB,RT -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace=@luma/web" "npm run start --workspace=@luma/realtime"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@luma/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@luma/realtime && npm run typecheck --workspace=@luma/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@luma/shared && npm run test --workspace=@luma/realtime
